title: "supp_mat_prereg_template"
format: html
---

Final Template Version & Changes

```{r}
#| label: preregistration-template-final
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(gtExtras)

prereg_tbl_data <-
  readr::read_csv(
    here::here("outputs/quarto_preregistration_template.csv")) %>%
  drop_na(phase) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ stringr::str_remove_all(.x, "\\*")),
         phase = forcats::as_factor(phase),
         step = forcats::as_factor(step),
         substep = forcats::as_factor(substep)) %>%
  mutate(phase_id = cur_group_id(), .by = phase) %>%
  group_by(pick(starts_with("phase"),
                starts_with("step"),
                starts_with("substep"),
                -ends_with("_id")),
           preregistration_item) %>%
  reframe(preregistration_subitem = list(preregistration_subitem),
          subitem_na = map_lgl(preregistration_subitem, rlang::is_na)) %>%
  group_by(pick(starts_with("phase"),
                starts_with("step"),
                starts_with("substep"),
                -ends_with("_id"),
                "subitem_na")) %>%
  reframe(preregistration_item =
            case_when(subitem_na ~ list(preregistration_item),
                      .default = map(preregistration_item, list)),
          preregistration_subitem =
            case_when(subitem_na ~ list(NA),
                      .default = map(preregistration_subitem,
                                     ~ gluedown::md_list(.x, type = "bullet", marker = "-")))) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(preregistration_item =
           list(gluedown::md_list(preregistration_item, type = "bullet", marker = "-"))) %>%
  arrange(phase, step, substep) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  mutate(step_id = 1:n(),
         step = case_when(step_id == 1 ~ step, .default = NA),
         step_description = case_when(step_id == 1 ~ step_description, .default = NA),
         .by = c(phase, step)) %>%
  mutate(substep_id = 1:n(),
         substep =
           case_when(substep_id == 1 ~ substep,
                     .default = NA),
         substep_description =
           case_when(substep_id == 1 ~ substep_description,
                     .default = NA),
         .by = c(phase, step, substep)) %>%
  mutate( phase = gluedown::md_bold(phase),
          phase_description = gluedown::md_italic(phase_description),
          across(ends_with("_id"), as.numeric)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(step =
           forcats::fct_relabel(step,
                                .fun = ~ if(!rlang::is_na(.x)) gluedown::md_bold(.x)),
         substep =
           forcats::fct_relabel(substep,
                                .fun = ~ if(!rlang::is_na(.x)) gluedown::md_bold(.x)),
         step_description =
           forcats::fct_relabel(step_description,
                                .fun = ~ if(!rlang::is_na(.x)) gluedown::md_italic(.x)),
         substep_description =
           forcats::fct_relabel(substep_description,
                                .fun = ~ if(!rlang::is_na(.x)) gluedown::md_italic(.x))) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  select(starts_with("phase"),
         starts_with("step"),
         starts_with("substep"),
         ends_with("_item"),
         ends_with("subitem"),
         everything(),
         -subitem_na)

prereg_tbl_data %>%
  gt::gt(
    groupname_col = c("phase", "phase_description"),
    rowname_col = "step",
    row_group.sep = ": ") %>%
  gt::cols_hide(ends_with("_id")) %>%
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  gt::cols_merge(columns = c("step", "step_description"),
                 pattern =   "{1}\n {2}",) %>%
  gt::cols_merge(columns = c("substep", "substep_description"),
                 pattern = "{1}\n {2}") %>%
  gt::text_transform(fn = gt::md,
                     locations = gt::cells_stub()) %>%
  gt::text_transform(fn = function(x) map(x, gt::md),
                     locations = gt::cells_row_groups()) %>%
  gt::text_transform(fn = gt::md, gt::cells_body()) %>%
  gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "") %>%
  gt::cols_align(align = "left") %>%
  # gt::cols_label(substep = "Substep") %>%
  # gt::tab_spanner(columns = starts_with("preregistration_item"),
                  # label = "Preregistration Items", gather = TRUE) %>%
  gt::tab_options(column_labels.hidden = TRUE, table.width = 10,table.font.size = 10) %>%
  gt::opt_stylize(2,color = "cyan") %>%
  gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_text(v_align = "top", whitespace = "break-spaces"),
                locations = cells_body()) %>%
   gt::tab_style(style = gt::cell_text(v_align = "top", whitespace = "break-spaces"),
                locations = cells_stub())
```
